fixed: "Left-hand star" and "Right hand star" (with or without a turn amount such as "3/4" or "once") are now read as a star left or star right when you type them or import them, instead of becoming a custom figure.

Caller's Companion imports also read other moves written with a hyphenated hand, such as "Left-hand allemande" or "Right-hand pull by", the way they read "Left allemande". Dances you imported before this keep those lines as custom figures unless you import them again; for stars, "Re-check custom figures" in Settings also picks them up.

changed: The shared figure parser's `star` recognizer reads a `left-hand`/`right-hand` token or a `left hand`/`right hand` pair as the star's hand.

`mapCallersCompanionDance` retries a body line the fan-out missed when it carries exactly one `left-hand`/`right-hand`, reading it with the bare side, and keeps the result only when it is a single noteless figure whose `hand` is that side.
